explanation: Persons sent to explore and gather information about a specific area, in this case Canaan.
The region God promised to give the people of Israel, later known as the Promised Land.
The prophet and leader of the people of Israel, who led them out of Egypt and toward the Promised Land.
One of the twelve spies sent to Canaan, and a future leader of the people of Israel.
Another of the twelve spies, known for his faithfulness and trust in God's promises.
Feedback or information that the spies gave to Moses and the people of Israel after their mission.
Large and strong people who lived in Canaan, which frightened some of the spies and created fear among the people of Israel.
Trust and conviction that God will keep His promises and give victory to His people.
A negative feeling that prevents people from trusting God and following His guidance.
The act of going against authority, in this case the people of Israel's lack of faith in God and Moses.
